<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Planning found (2026-11-04): pij-fleet has no prd/ folder under its government root; AGENTS.md's Governance section points at <government-root>/prd/base-prd.dd.json, which does not exist here. The earlier register lives in a private repo, frozen at commit e05661c8 (2026-09-07): schema prd/requirements, 54 rows, of which 40 are open (36 unchecked, 4 open) and 14 are done (10 checked, 4 shipped). pij-fleet is public, and the rows cite private PRs, machine paths and other projects. Ruling C15: leave the register where it is; triage the open rows into a fresh PRD 002 in new words with no private references. C11 and C12 still govern state, priority and done_when for the rows kept. PRD number 002 is claimed for this plan by pm-001.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- pij's live requirements are in docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json under pij/prd, beside PRD 001.
- Every open row of the earlier register gets one verdict against today's code: kept and rewritten into PRD 002, or dropped with a reason.
- Nothing private, and no copied text, reaches the public repo.
- AGENTS.md and the pij skill point at PRD 002, not at a path that does not exist here.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Copying, converting or publishing the earlier register, its done rows or its wording (C15).
- Editing the private repo or adding a pointer there.
- New requirements the earlier register did not have; those go through the PRD procedure (s13).
